_source: Condition cards (20 faces; 7 double-sided pairs via flipSide). type body|mind (Malediction has no band).

iconLegend.[Attack action]: black box with figure and sword

conditions.name: Exposed
conditions.text:
You have -2 Evasion [Evasion].
Discard this Condition card after you perform an Evasion Roll.
You may spend a [Move action] or a [Attack action] to discard this Condition card.
conditions.squire: Lower the number of evaded hits by 1.
unclear: The two black-box icons in 'spend a [..] or a [..]' read as Move action / Attack action (same glyphs used on the Tower card's Lunging Attack); not 100% certain.

conditions.name: Choked
conditions.text:
Your [Heat] cannot become equal to or lower than the Choke Limit. You or an adjacent Knight may spend a [Move action] or a [Attack action] to lower your Choke Limit by 3.
Discard this Condition card and the Choke Limit marker if you lower your Choke Limit to 0.
unclear: Black-box action icons read as Move action / Attack action (see Exposed).

conditions.name: Courage
conditions.text:
You have +2 Precision [Precision] and Auto-break 1.
Discard this Condition card if you fully miss an Attack or fail to deal a Wound.

conditions.name: Panzer Parasite
conditions.text: Whenever you're attacked by a Monster, treat X dice as hits without rolling them, where X is the number of tokens on this card. Gain Armor Re-roll X. If there are ever 5 or more tokens on this card, you are consumed by the Parasite (die).
conditions.squire: Whenever you're attacked by a Monster, treat X dice as hits before drawing from the Mettle deck (they can't be evaded).

conditions.name: Baptized in Metal
conditions.text:
You can't be moved to the Oubliette.
When you Bargain, you may ignore „A” cards. (You still shuffle the discard pile into the deck after you Bargain.)
Other Knights: Escape Difficulty +1.

conditions.name: Called by the Heavens
conditions.text:
If you are on a Tower Terrain tile during a Monster Attack, apply all of its Gated Effects. When you move onto a VP, discard this card.
End of your turn: Move 3 spaces toward the closest Tower Terrain tile along the shortest path. Then, if you are on a Tower Terrain tile, gain +1 [Passion].
unclear: Code is faint; read as 09B0460 (could be 09B0450).

conditions.name: Clear Mind
conditions.text: If you would gain the Subjugated Condition card, ignore that gain. Discard this card at the end of the next Round.
unclear: No code visible on this side.

conditions.name: Dread
conditions.text:
You have -4 Precision [Precision]. While on a Rear [Rear] space, you have -2 Precision [Precision] instead. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Fear Condition card, you die.
Face Your Fear: When you deal a Wound, discard this Condition card and place 2 permanent positive Precision [Precision] tokens on your Knight Board.
unclear: No code visible on this side.

conditions.name: Drowning
conditions.text:
When you're about to move voluntarily, roll [white Armor die] and all your Armor dice. For each [Potential] gain +1 [Heat].
If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Slimed Condition card, you die.
End of your turn: If you didn't move during your turn, you die.
When you move voluntarily, flip this card.
unclear: No code visible on this side.
notes: 주사위 아이콘 = white Armor die, 잔 = Potential (사용자 확인 2026-11-03)

conditions.name: Knockdown (Standing Up)
conditions.text:
If you move voluntarily, attack, or use an action, active ability, or a Technique, stand up. At the start of your turn, stand up.
If this card is discarded by another effect, stand up.
Stand Up: Put your miniature in the normal position and discard this card.
unclear: No code visible on this side.

conditions.name: Malediction (Manifested)
conditions.text:
Start of your turn: Flip this card. You cannot attack. Ignore Swamp Terrain tiles during movement. During an Attack against you, for each hit lose an additional -1 [Vigor].
Flip and Exchange: If you are adjacent to another Knight, as a free action, you may flip this card and pass it to them.
unclear: Bottom band is a decorative border with no BODY/MIND CONDITION label; type left null.
No code visible on this side.

conditions.name: Panicked
conditions.text:
Lower your Hand Limit by 4. Place cards over your limit under this card.
If you discard this card, add them back to your hand.
conditions.squire: Active Squire abilities cost +2 [Heat] to use.
unclear: No code visible on this side.

conditions.name: Toxified
conditions.text:
End of your turn: Roll a [Red Power die]. For each [Power] rolled gain an additional Poison token. Then, lose -1 [Vigor] for each token on this card.
Do not discard this card if you have 0 Poison tokens.
unclear: Die icon is a red die with a sword face (read as red Power die).
No code visible on this side.

conditions.name: Subjugated
conditions.text:
You must Obey all Commands.
If you gain this Condition card a second time, you die.
Start of your turn: You may test a chosen Virtue (9+).
Success: Flip this card.

conditions.name: Fear
conditions.text:
You have -2 Precision [Precision]. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Dread Condition card, flip this card.
Face Your Fear: When you deal a Wound, discard this Condition card and place a permanent positive Precision [Precision] token on your Knight Board.

conditions.name: Slimed
conditions.text:
When you're about to move voluntarily, roll [black Armor die] and all your Armor dice. For each [Potential] gain +1 [Heat].
If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Drowning Condition card, flip this card.
End of your turn: If you didn't move during your turn, flip this card.
When you move voluntarily, discard this card and gain a temporary positive Speed [Speed] token.
notes: 주사위 아이콘 = black Armor die, 잔 = Potential (사용자 확인 2026-11-03)

conditions.name: Knockdown (Falling Down)
conditions.text:
You are knocked down. Place your miniature on its side as a reminder.
You cannot move voluntarily, attack, or use actions, active abilities, or Techniques, unless stated otherwise.
If this card is discarded by another effect, stand up (see the other side of the card).
At the end of your next turn, flip this card.

conditions.name: Malediction (Dormant)
conditions.text:
Start of your turn: Flip this card.
Exchange: If you are adjacent to another Knight, as a free action, you may pass this card to them.
unclear: Bottom band is a decorative border with no BODY/MIND CONDITION label; type left null.

conditions.name: Distracted
conditions.text:
Lower your Hand Limit by 2. Place cards over your limit under this card.
If you discard this card, add them back to your hand.
If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Panicked Condition card, flip this card.
conditions.squire: Active Squire abilities cost +1 [Heat] to use.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.text:
End of your turn: Lose -1 [Vigor] for each token on this card. If your [Vigor] would drop to 0 or below, it stays at 1 instead.
Poison Limit: 3
If there are 0 Poison tokens on this card, discard it.
If Poison tokens on this card exceed your Poison Limit, flip this card (move tokens to the other side).
